name: Shodan apex web host (shodan.io)
tier_rationale: Shodan LLC, an established company with published terms and a business offering (A8 trusted; same operator as the core provider shodan); P062 records tier trusted and P304 cond 5 'trusted - ... Shodan'.

reliability.justification: Shodan host and search pages show internet-wide scan observations that may be days old; manual links only.

web_pages.title: Shodan search and host pages via the apex host (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: Free web UI; provider ToS apply (manual analyst use)

web_pages.notes: Quote: research C0128 terms (status unverified 403: Cloudflare challenge for scripts; A9 manual links only). Pages that require a login (e.g. Shodan search) are excluded by the P311 lint (P304 cond 9). Used by favicon_hash (http.favicon.hash pivots) and pivots_unverified.

notes: Shared seed for batches p2-G14-3, p9-G03-1 (P062, P304): batches only extend it (shodan_web__<suffix>.json: extra sources and error markers). Owns only the apex shodan.io that P062/P304 list; the apex redirects to www.shodan.io, which the research templates use and which belongs to core shodan: templates should prefer www.shodan.io, and any www source is added by a shodan__<batch>.json extension. V3LUM never fetches these pages.
